method: 100 in-page keystroke transactions per scenario; domSamples are measured to the first content MutationObserver callback, paintSamples to the next requestAnimationFrame. Real CDP keyboard presses were used as a sanity check before the stable in-page batches.
interpretation: Application work is under one 60 Hz frame in both scenarios. The paint interval includes the wait for the next frame, so its p95 is frame-bound rather than work-bound.
